horse_owner.commercial_operation.notes: Professional boarding and retirement facility on 170 acres with multiple barns. Owner Ann Bakhaus operates full-time with published pricing ($775 full board, $450 pasture board). Mission statement: 'give the highest quality care to our horses.' Services: boarding, retirement, riding lessons, workshops/clinics.

horse_owner.more_than_three_horses.notes: Horse count not explicitly published. However, facility has multiple barns (A, B, C), 20+ fields and paddocks, boarders since 2020, multiple breeds housed. Strong commercial signals clearly indicate >3 horses but the exact count is not stated on the website. This will trigger the threshold exception review pathway.

horse_owner.purchasing_influence.notes: The farm schedules routine blacksmith and vet when needed. As the boarding facility operator, Ann Bakhaus influences which farrier and hoof-care services are used for boarder horses. The boarding agreement states: 'We schedule routine blacksmith and vet when needed. (If you use anyone other than the farm blacksmith or vet, you must schedule them yourself and be there to meet them).'

horse_owner.product_fit.notes: Professional boarding operation with routine blacksmith scheduling, hoof trimming included in mare retirement 'Spa Day' service. Regular need for horseshoes, nails, and hoof-care products for multiple horses across multiple disciplines.

horse_owner.performance_discipline.notes: Facility has jumps in both indoor and outdoor arenas, offers riding lessons, serves multiple disciplines. Boarders include hunters, jumpers, dressage riders. Breeds include Thoroughbreds, Warmbloods, Oldenburgs — sport and performance horse disciplines.

horse_owner.breeding_activity.notes: Farm was originally a Thoroughbred breeding operation but transitioned to a full boarding farm. No evidence of current breeding activity.

horse_owner.professional_network.notes: Works with professional farriers (farm blacksmith), veterinarians, riding instructors, and hosts workshops/clinics. Serves riders of all ages, levels, and disciplines.

horse_owner.high_equine_activity_locatio.notes: Located in Lexington, Kentucky — the heart of Central Kentucky's horse country, near Keeneland racecourse. One of the highest equine-activity regions in the United States.

horse_owner.buying_signal.notes: No recent buying, expansion, or acquisition signals found on the website beyond continued operation. The farm appears established rather than recently expanded.

horse_owner.single_horse_recreational.notes: The operation is a professional boarding facility with multiple horses, multiple barns, full-time staff, published commercial pricing — clearly not a single-horse recreational setup.

horse_owner.no_commercial_evidence.notes: Strong commercial evidence: published pricing, multiple barns, 170-acre facility, professional website with boarding services, owner operator, blacksmith/vet scheduling, boarder testimonials.
